benchmark_name: WASP-39 b Cross-Observation Water Predictive Benchmark
independence_evidence: Verified independent observing visits: Fitting observation is Near Infrared Spectrograph (NIRSpec) - G395H (Prog 1366, Visit 02, observed 2022-07-30/31), while validation observation is Near Infrared Spectrograph (NIRSpec) - PRISM (Prog 1366, Visit 01, observed 2022-07-10/11). The datasets represent separate physical transits separated in time with distinct instrument readouts.

opacity_provenance.pressure_treatment: Doppler broadening at zero pressure; pressure-broadened wings neglected
opacity_provenance.approximation_justification: The 500 K POKAZATEL zero-pressure cross section preserves fundamental vibrational band centers (2.7-3.3 µm) and envelope structure, allowing comparative testing of band contrast vs continuum. Higher-energy thermal state populations and pressure broadening are known approximations.
opacity_provenance.missing_requirement: High-temperature cross section tabulated at T=1166 K, P=0.01 bar with H2/He line broadening. Can be generated via ExoMol cross-section ingestion workflow once online access is authorized.

band_definition.name: WASP-39 b 3.10-3.30 µm Water Band (Holdout Window)
band_definition.scientific_justification: Evaluates the 3.10-3.30 µm water feature relative to local continuum reference levels at 2.80-3.00 µm and 3.40-3.60 µm across separate visits.

comparison.outcome_decision: This observation cannot distinguish the models.
comparison.plain_language_summary: This observation cannot distinguish the models. Both the physical water model (contrast error = 243.7 ppm) and the flat continuum baseline (contrast error = 273.4 ppm) predict band contrasts within the 2-sigma observational uncertainty interval (±72.1 ppm) of the validation observation. While adding water improved the training fit on NIRSpec G395H by 83.0 ppm, the separate NIRSpec PRISM observation's per-bin measurement scatter is comparable to the contrast difference, preventing a statistically decisive preference between the two models on this feature.
